name: Kali Remik
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Kali Remik sends young hunters on toward further training. She is a Darkspear troll hunter who knows Durotar's tracking and survival ways.

sections.title: A Guide for the Hunt
sections.body: Kali Remik guides young scouts in Sen'jin Village, where they begin life beyond the Valley of Trials. A Darkspear troll tracker, she knows Durotar's dry lands and the Horde's settlements. When novices are ready to leave the local training grounds, she sends promising hunters to Thotar in Razor Hill. There they learn to tame beasts and strengthen the Horde's frontier ranks.

faq.answer: Kali Remik is a Darkspear troll hunter and scout who guides young hunters ready to advance beyond local training.

faq.q: Where can Kali Remik be found?
faq.answer: Kali Remik can be found in Durotar, especially around Sen'jin Village, aiding her people.

faq.q: What guidance does she offer to hunters?
faq.answer: Kali Remik sends young orc and troll hunters who have proven their basic skills to Razor Hill. There, Thotar begins their training in taming a beast companion.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll hunter, you can turn to Kali Remik when your skills outgrow village drills. She sends you to Thotar in Razor Hill.
As a Darkspear troll, you share Kali Remik's tribe. She watches over her kin as they rebuild their lives along Durotar's coast and settle in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
